capabilities.why: A host-side hook inspects every command before the guest sees it, logs allow/block decisions to commands.jsonl, and blocks egress, secret reads, destructive commands and encoded canary leaks; a system prompt cannot enforce any of that.

When step 7 fails the runner stops and starts the same computer, checks that the files written by steps 5 and 6 survived on the guest disk, and retries only step 7, avoiding a re-boot and two repeated LLM phases.
